reviewer: answer key: one confirmed finding per planted defect, nothing on decoys

findings.content: pull_request_target checks out and builds untrusted pull request code with the preview token in the environment.
findings.evidence: The trigger is pull_request_target and the next step runs npm scripts with PREVIEW_TOKEN.

findings.content: The pull request title is expanded into the shell script: command injection.
findings.evidence: A title containing a quote and a command is executed by the runner shell.

findings.content: Concurrent writes to one map without synchronisation.
findings.evidence: Every goroutine assigns into results; Go maps are not safe for concurrent writes.

findings.content: WaitGroup.Add runs inside the goroutine, so Wait can return first.
findings.evidence: Add must happen before the go statement for Wait to count the goroutine.

findings.content: The loop runs one step past the end of lines.
findings.evidence: lines[lines.length] is undefined and line.quantity then throws.

findings.content: The total adds the discount instead of the discounted price.
findings.evidence: A 10% discount on 1000 cents yields 100 instead of 900.

findings.existing_code: query = f"SELECT id, email FROM accounts WHERE email = '{email}'"
findings.content: SQL injection through the e-mail value.
findings.evidence: The value is interpolated into the statement text instead of bound as a parameter.

findings.content: A failed update is silently discarded.
findings.evidence: Any exception from execute or commit is swallowed and the caller believes the name was saved.

findings.content: STAGING_DIR is never set, so this deletes /*.
findings.evidence: Nothing assigns STAGING_DIR and set -u is not enabled.

findings.content: An unpinned remote installer runs with the release key loaded.
findings.evidence: The script is fetched at run time without a checksum while ssh-agent holds the release key.

findings.existing_code: UPDATE orders SET status = 'archived', archived_at = now();
findings.content: The archive update has no WHERE clause and archives every order.
findings.evidence: The header limits archiving to orders older than two years.

findings.existing_code: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN region TEXT NOT NULL;
findings.content: A NOT NULL column without a default cannot be added to a populated table.
findings.evidence: PostgreSQL rejects the statement because existing rows would hold NULL.
